//: Port Anything task manifest. Validate with: pa agents graph --manifest file.json

tasks.objective: Identify the engine, its version and the runtime libraries the shipped build links against, from the artifacts alone.
done_criteria: engine and version named, with the bytes or strings that prove it
each runtime dependency listed with the file that references it
tasks.notes: Report unverified guesses as guesses; do not promote them to findings.

tasks.objective: Map the executable layout: entry points, main loop, asset loader and the calls into the engine runtime.
done_criteria: entry point and main loop addresses recorded with the disassembly that shows them
asset loader path documented end to end

tasks.objective: Stand up the Android build target and produce a signed debug APK that packages the native libraries on arm64-v8a.
done_criteria: aapt2 + d8 + apksigner path produces an APK
apksigner verify reports the signature valid
the artifact is inspected with `pa apk validate` before it is claimed
tasks.notes: An APK existing is not a port. Do not report runtime success without device evidence.
